      • newGame

        public void newGame​(java.lang.String board,
                    java.lang.String p1,
                    java.lang.String p2,
                    CollectoServerGame game)
        Sends the NEWGAME protocol to the client containing the state of the board and the player order and names.
        Parameters:
        board - : the Board on which will be played.
        p1 - the user name of player 1.
        p2 - the user name of player 2.
        game - : the CollectoServerGame instance which handles the game logic.
        Requires
        state != State.IN_GAME, board != null, p1 != null, p2 != null, game != null.
        Ensures
        state = State.IN_GAME, this.game = game.

      • showError

        public void showError​(java.lang.String description)
               throws java.io.IOException
        Sends the ERROR protocol to the connected client. This is called when an invalid move has been sent to this client handler or when a move has been sent while it is not tis client handler's turn in the game.
        Parameters:
        description - : the description of the error
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - Signals that an I/O exception has occurred. Generally indicates client has disconnected.
        Requires
        description != null.

      • sendMove

        public void sendMove​(int[] move)
        Implements the MOVE protocol and sends the passed move to the client.
        Parameters:
        move - : the move to be sent to the client as an Integer array.
        Requires
        move != null, out != null.

      • gameOver

        public void gameOver​(java.lang.String condition)
        Implements the GAMEOVER protocol and dereferences the game of this client handler and returns the state to INITIALIZED. This method should only be called when this client handler is in a game.
        Parameters:
        condition - : the description of the condition for the game over.
        Requires
        State.IN_GAME, condition != null, out != null.
        Ensures
        game = null, state = State.INITIALIZED.
